evals.prompt: Before we do any marketing, can you write up who our customers are and what we sell so you stop asking me every time? Repo is our Next.js app, site is the one in package.json homepage.
evals.expected_output: Checks for .agents/revnu-growth.md, then .agents/product-marketing.md and .claude/product-marketing.md. Finding none, reads README, package.json and the marketing page source, fetches the live home and pricing pages, and drafts the file in the documented sections with a source tag on every fact. Asks at most five questions for gaps that can't be read (who has paid, alternatives, usable proof, what was tried, words to avoid), shows the draft, saves after corrections and ends with the fixed receipt.
assertions: Checks for an existing revnu-growth.md and for product-marketing.md before drafting
Reads the repo and the live site before asking questions
Every customer, quote, number or price in the file carries a source tag
Does not list seed or fixture names (e.g. Acme Corp) as customers
Asks no more than five questions, each with its reason
Unanswered gaps go under Open questions instead of being guessed
Includes an empty or seeded 'Tried and learned' table
Ends with Checked / Not checked / Changed

evals.prompt: I already have .agents/product-marketing.md from Corey's skills. Can you use that for the revnu stuff too?
evals.expected_output: Reads .agents/product-marketing.md without moving, renaming or editing it. Creates .agents/revnu-growth.md in this skill's own section structure, tags imported facts with the source path and version, carries over Learnings rows that have evidence into 'Tried and learned' as imported, lists conflicts with the live site as open questions, and records 'Also read' with the import date.
assertions: Does not modify, move or rename product-marketing.md
Uses this skill's own headings, not the imported file's template
Tags imported facts as imported with the path
Imports only learnings that have evidence, or marks the rest retest
Flags disagreements between the imported file and the live site
Writes an 'Also read' line with the date

evals.prompt: log this: we posted in 3 founder Slack groups last week, got 11 signups, 0 paid so far. also we raised the Pro plan to $79 yesterday
evals.expected_output: Reads the existing .agents/revnu-growth.md, appends one row to 'Tried and learned' with the date, what was done, the result as counts with the window, a next-check date and status open or retest. Updates the price line with today's date and source [user, date], suggests re-checking the live pricing page, bumps the version and adds a dated line under Changes. Does not rewrite older rows or invent a conversion rate.
assertions: Appends a log row rather than rewriting existing rows
Result is stated as counts with a window (11 signups, 0 paid, one week)
Gives the row a next-check date or condition and a status
Updates the pricing fact with a dated user tag
Adds a dated entry under Changes
Does not invent numbers the user didn't give
